chengdu-2005.notes: The Chinese contest site's results page and problems archive (problems.zip) are linked but not in our copy. Source 3 (problems.htm) has no stored copy, although the crawl in source 1 holds a page at that address which only offers the problems archive.

sources.evidence: The /icpc/ pages are headed 第30届ACM国际大学生程序设计竞赛亚洲区成都赛区预选赛 and give the 2005 online round on 25 September and the on-site contest on 5-6 November 2005 at Sichuan University, while the seed page and the online judge pages are of other kinds.
Table titled The 2005 ACM Asia Programming Contest - ChengDu with 468 team rows and columns Rank, Team, Citation, #Solved, Time.

chengdu-2007.notes: Source 2 lists 924 teams, far more than the 88 on-site teams of source 4; the page does not say whether it includes the online round. Source 3's capture is a placeholder; the filled results page is inside source 1.

sources.evidence: The site is Xihua University's ACM/ICPC site headed with the 32nd ACM ICPC Asia Chengdu regional (2007), with background, organisation, rules, schedule, results and registration pages.
A View Standings table headed 'The 2007 ACM Asia Programming Contest - Chengdu' with columns Rank, Team, Citation, #Solved and Time.
The page shows only a heading 'Results' (竞赛结果) and the words 'under construction' (正在建设中) between the site menu and the copyright line.
The page is headed with the list of schools and team numbers qualified for the on-site contest of the 32nd ACM ICPC Asia regional (Chengdu).

chengdu-2008.notes: Source 2 (news item with final ranking) has no copy; the website copy does not hold the regional's final ranking. The only scoreboard inside source 1 is of the Sichuan provincial contest.

sources.evidence: Site titled SWUN-ACM/ICPC 2008 with the footer 'The ACM-ICPC Asia Regional Contest Chengdu Site 2008 hosted by Southwest University for Nationalities' and the schedule of the 33rd Asia regional at Chengdu, 28 to 30 November 2008.

chengdu-2010.notes: Sources 2 and 3 list 126 teams including 11 starred teams; source 4 lists 112 teams. The starred teams are not explained on either page.

sources.evidence: Ranklist page headed 2010 成都赛区现场赛 (Chengdu on-site contest) with 126 team rows and problem columns A to K.
Table of 126 team rows with columns School, Team, *, Solved, Time, Rank and a gold or silver medal column, as the 2010 Chengdu on-site results.
Table of 112 teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the heading The 2010 ACM-ICPC Asia Chengdu Regional Contest.

chengdu-2011.notes: Source 2 lists 141 team rows (8 starred) against 132 in source 3. Source 1 holds only link posts, no results.

sources.evidence: Seven news posts in the Contest Results section of the Chengdu Neusoft Institute's ACM/ICPC Chengdu regional site, dated September to November 2011, about the 36th regional's online round and on-site contest.
Ranklist page headed 2011 成都赛区现场赛 (Chengdu on-site contest) with 141 team rows and problem columns A to J.
Table of 132 teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the heading The 2011 ACM-ICPC Asia Chengdu Regional Contest.

chengdu-2012.notes: Source 2 has 146 team rows including 5 starred; sources 3 and 4 have 141 teams (146 minus 5). The star is not explained on the page. Source 1 mostly holds later NSUOJ pages unrelated to the contest.

sources.evidence: Site of the 37th ACM-ICPC Asia Chengdu regional hosted by Chengdu Neusoft Institute, with 2012 news posts on rules, registration and the list of schools qualified for the on-site contest.
Ranklist page headed 2012 成都赛区现场赛 (Chengdu on-site contest) with 146 team rows and problem columns A to K.
Page headed Standings for The 2012 ACM-ICPC Asia Chengdu Regional Contest with a table of 141 teams and columns Place, Institution, Team, Problems solved, Total time, Last solution.
Table of 141 teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the heading The 2012 ACM-ICPC Asia Chengdu Regional Contest.

chengdu-2013.notes: The crawl is almost entirely UESTC online judge pages; only the seed front page of the contest site is held.

sources.evidence: The seed is the UESTC WordPress site titled 2013 ACM-ICPC Asia Regional Contest (Chengdu Site) with notices dated 2013, plus pages of the UESTC online judge.
Ranklist titled 2013 成都赛区现场赛 with 165 ranked rows, columns S#, School, Rk, Team, Slv., Time and cells A to J with tries and minutes.
Table of 151 rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, titled The 2013 ACM-ICPC Asia Chengdu Regional Contest.
Contest problem list titled 2013ACM/ICPC亚洲区成都站现场赛――题目重现 with ten problems 1001 to 1010 whose titles match the catalogue list A to J.
Codeforces gym standings page headed Final standings with 13 problem columns A to M, +/- tries and times, 200 rows shown.
Table of 307 rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation, titled The 2024 ICPC Asia Chengdu Regional Contest.
Codeforces gym dashboard listing 13 problems A to M with links to English statements and a Chinese tutorial.
